Native generated seed-42 terrain rendered via installed engine scene lifecycle in PID24860. All three runs completed without a crash; old procedural-mesh crash probes were not rerun.

Evidence: evidence/runtime/in-game/native-render-24860.{json,log,png}; sandbox_boot-25644.*; sandbox_boot-23152.{json,log,png}; sandbox_boot-23152-observation.json. Final module SHA256 3991b6ff2ee200bbde4104b1dcf40e40dea2ff344195ec3a5b771205ae838180. Source build/deployed/runtime hashes agree. Existing saves unchanged; no new saves; game exited. See evidence/runtime/render-and-sandbox-verification.json. Build and offline fixture validation passed; independent source review found no blocking defects. Root independently verified latest screenshot/runtime after review's first-boot evidence.

Main menu now exposes native terrain preview and paused Sandbox terrain test; shared startup path verified via autorun, menu click not separately exercised. README and runtime capability docs updated.

Limits: diagnostic fixture retains official campaign IDs, settlement XY, navigation topology/regions, weather/battle grids and distance caches. Generated terrain and grounded entities/nav vertices are real; generated campaign content/nav gameplay, wrapping, movement, mission transitions and world-bound save/load are NOT accepted. Extracted official scaffold remains local ignored build output. No ticket or epic completion is claimed beyond this requested rendering/boot milestone.
